title.zh: P0 共同复核与纠错接力单元：预实施证据包
title.en: P0 Civic Review and Correction Relay Cell: Pre-implementation Evidence Package

public_test.zh: 一条错误如果不能沿原渠道被纠正，这项AI服务就不能留在京张。
public_test.en: If an error cannot be corrected through every channel that carried it, the AI service must not remain in Jing-Zhang.

authority_boundary.zh: 本包把既有PILOT-A转成可计算的参赛者参考测试装配，不是场地测绘、建筑方案、消防或无障碍合规结论、正式估算、采购批准或运营承诺。
authority_boundary.en: This package turns the existing PILOT-A into a computable participant reference test fit. It is not a site survey, building design, fire or accessibility compliance conclusion, formal estimate, procurement approval or operating commitment.

envelope.derivation: A separate physical test-fit assumption maps the existing 12 by 8 adjacency pattern to metres for this P0 only; the source diagram remains non-metric.

zones.name_zh: 无屏入口与原渠道更正带
zones.name_en: Screenless entry and same-channel correction band

zones.name_zh: 独立复核人员入口与共同校译
zones.name_en: Independent reviewer access and civic translation

accessibility_working_envelope.required_check: authorized field survey, applicable-code review and co-testing with actual users before any physical release

flows.public: screenless entry -> intake -> explanation -> correction receipt -> exit
flows.controlled_evidence: records store -> independent review -> channel owner -> retest handover
flows.recovery: pause -> isolate material -> correct channels -> remove equipment and cached copies -> sign recovery

drawing_chain: 1:20 screenless counter, paper receipt and removable interface

operational_screening.admission_rule: When the active queue reaches eight people or demand exceeds the two-case-per-hour screening envelope, stop walk-in admission, keep urgent human explanation available, and add appointments or an independent second review seat before reopening.

independence_constraints: original_channel_owner must not serve as independent reviewer for the same case
material author or supplier must not serve as independent reviewer
service owner must not approve their own unresolved adverse conclusion

reference_90_day_schedule.formula: 4 hours x 3 windows x 13 weeks x 5 concurrent seats

staffing_screening.annual_fte_reason: Named operator, opening hours, productive-hour convention, leave, training and relief factors are not authorized.

packages.release_evidence: source, licence, site-use and channel inventory

packages.scope_zh: 可逆空间适配与无障碍工作包
packages.scope_en: Reversible fit-out and accessibility work package
packages.release_evidence: surveyed dimensions, applicable-code review, removal and route test

packages.scope_zh: 离线设备、纸面收据与标识
packages.scope_en: Offline equipment, paper receipts and signs
packages.release_evidence: asset register, offline test and readable bilingual labels

packages.scope_zh: 渠道接入、故障注入与回送测试
packages.scope_en: Channel connection, failure injection and return testing
packages.release_evidence: channel-owner agreement and correction acknowledgement test

packages.scope_en: Ninety-day staffing, independent review and operation
packages.release_evidence: appointed roster, conflict check, training and operating log

packages.scope_zh: 退役、数据清理与空间恢复储备
packages.scope_en: Retirement, data clearance and spatial-recovery reserve

procurement_cost_plan.monetary_update_rule: Add low/high CNY bands only after quantities, a dated authoritative or professionally cleared rate basis and owner review are recorded in sources; never label a participant band as a tender price.

maintenance_and_recovery.action: reconcile case IDs, two-channel inventory and paper receipts; reset synthetic material
test the no-phone route, channel reachability, expiry dates, printer and offline terminal
review conflicts, unresolved cases, accessibility barriers and pause decisions
complete missing-role, missing-channel, reviewer-outage and recovery-record failure injections
remove temporary equipment, close materials, caches and backups, restore the space and sign adopt/modify/retire

external_gates.required_evidence: named entity, site-use scope, dates and signatory authority

external_gates.name_zh: 原渠道责任与更正回送协议
external_gates.required_evidence: complete channel inventory, named owner and acknowledgement method

external_gates.name_zh: 独立复核任命与利益冲突
external_gates.required_evidence: qualification, appointment, recusal and replacement procedure

external_gates.name_zh: 网络安全、离线切换与回滚
external_gates.required_evidence: bounded interface inventory, offline test, rollback and incident route
appointed roster, sourced quantities and rates, funding and insurance basis
asset, material, cache, backup and space closure signed by required roles

conditional_implementation_branches.primary: fixed civic review and correction relay cell
conditional_implementation_branches.safe_state: staffed mobile counter plus a separately bookable private room
conditional_implementation_branches.preserves: screenless intake, privacy, independent review, paper receipt and same-channel correction
conditional_implementation_branches.temporarily_loses: permanent ground-floor spatial identity and fixed controlled store
conditional_implementation_branches.prohibition: do not claim a permanent built Civic Review Hall
conditional_implementation_branches.return_condition: host permission, measured room, engineering and accessibility release

conditional_implementation_branches.safe_state: single-site offline tabletop relay with role and receipt handovers
conditional_implementation_branches.preserves: six-moment correction chain, independent review, fail-closed tests and recovery receipt
conditional_implementation_branches.temporarily_loses: real cross-site travel, organization handover and live service evidence
conditional_implementation_branches.prohibition: do not report three-area field performance
conditional_implementation_branches.return_condition: joint host, channel-owner and staffing authorization

conditional_implementation_branches.preserves: complete channel inventory, accountable owner, version and acknowledgement
conditional_implementation_branches.prohibition: do not claim automatic or instant correction
conditional_implementation_branches.return_condition: reviewed interface, security test and rollback evidence

conditional_implementation_branches.safe_state: offline synthetic evidence kit, paper case ID and human custody
conditional_implementation_branches.preserves: public explanation, no-phone route, independent review and fail-closed decision
conditional_implementation_branches.temporarily_loses: live data, remote interfaces and public-channel operation
conditional_implementation_branches.prohibition: do not ingest personal material or open real public channels

currently_judgeable: six reference zones sum to the 96 sqm test-fit envelope
six procurement shares sum to 100 percent
all ten external gates remain HOLD and field release is false
all four safe branches map to explicit gates and preserve the public correction invariant
four missing-field injections produce 4/4 pause or retirement states
eight RACI actions and nine unappointed role classes remain inspectable
field_dependent: measured room, accessible route, engineering and fire conclusions
actual arrival, queue, service time and staff workload
actual quantities, rates, quotes, funding and operating cost
screenless parity, user understanding, appeals and correction time
real decommissioning and asset, data and space recovery
